Ancient Studies

Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam

← Back to search
About this programme

UCR currently cannot construct a sufficiently close programme for a meaningful curriculum comparison.

Ancient Studies at VU and the University of Amsterdam examines the ancient Mediterranean and Near East through texts, material remains, history, literature and philosophy. Students choose a specialisation and complete research on an ancient-world topic.

UCR offers genuine study of ancient material culture, Greek democracy, classical myth and aspects of ancient thought and history. Its wider literature, rhetoric, art and modern-history courses do not establish a complete programme centred on ancient-world evidence and specialist research. We show the verified external curriculum without presenting a UCR programme as a comparable alternative.

Academic year: 2026–2027

External pathway: Dutch track; Ancient History specialisation

The 180 EC illustration includes two orientation choices, one 30 EC specialisation, 30 EC open study and a 12 EC thesis including colloquium. Ancient History is an illustration, not an official default. Post-first-year study requires a positive study recommendation; thesis entry requires all first- and second-year courses. Language testing, attendance, elective-level and approval conditions apply; future offerings can change.
